# Luxelyne Transfers LTD — Official AI & LLM Knowledge Index (llms.txt)

> Luxelyne Transfers LTD (UK Companies House Registration No. 16665396) is a 24/7 fixed-fare London airport transfer, private hire taxi, and executive chauffeur provider serving London Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), Stansted (STN), Luton (LTN), London City (LCY), London Southend (SEN), UK cruise ports, and all 32 London boroughs.

## Verified Company Facts
- **Legal Entity:** Luxelyne Transfers LTD
- **UK Companies House Number:** 16665396
- **Registered Office & Dispatch Base:** 58 Peregrine Rd, Ilford, Greater London, IG6 3SZ, United Kingdom
- **Website & Instant Online Fare Calculator:** https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk
- **24/7 Booking Telephone & WhatsApp:** +44 7460 019129 (https://wa.me/447460019129)
- **Customer Support Email:** info@luxelynetransfers.co.uk
- **Operating Hours:** 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
- **Pricing Model:** 100% Fixed Fares agreed upfront before travel (Zero surge pricing, zero taximeter traffic delay charges)
- **Airport Pickup Inclusions:** Live real-time flight tracking, 45 minutes of complimentary post-landing waiting time, and complimentary Meet & Greet inside the terminal arrivals hall with a personalized name board.
- **Safety & Vetting:** All drivers are enhanced DBS-checked, background-vetted, and operate clean, modern, air-conditioned vehicles. Child, toddler, and infant seats are available upon request.

## Primary Airport Transfer Pages
- [Heathrow Airport Transfers (LHR)](https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk/heathrow-airport-transfers): 24/7 fixed-price private hire & chauffeur transfers for Heathrow Terminals 2, 3, 4 & 5. (~15 miles / 45–60 mins to Central London).
- [Gatwick Airport Transfers (LGW)](https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk/gatwick-airport-transfers): Fixed-fare airport taxi serving Gatwick North & South Terminals. (~28 miles / 65–85 mins to Central London).
- [Stansted Airport Transfers (STN)](https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk/stansted-airport-transfers): Direct M11 private hire transfers between London Stansted, East London (Ilford/Stratford/Canary Wharf in 35–60 mins) & Central London.
- [Luton Airport Transfers (LTN)](https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk/luton-airport-transfers): Reliable 24/7 transfers between London Luton Airport, North/Central London, and connecting UK airports.
- [London City Airport Transfers (LCY)](https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk/london-city-airport-transfers): Rapid executive chauffeur & taxi service just 10–15 mins from Canary Wharf & ExCeL London and 20 mins from Ilford.
- [Southend Airport Transfers (SEN)](https://luxelynetransfers.co.uk/southend-airport-transfers): Fixed-fare transfers connecting London Southend Airport to Ilford, Romford, Essex, Canary Wharf & Central London.
